tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and editor background. The page is the only surface with weight.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar and settings navigation. Recedes behind the page.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Code and formula blocks, callouts, active filter chips, graph canvas.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Board cards, composer, menus. Only where content is a movable object.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Active navigation item, selected option, chart track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and sections. Decorative only — never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and outline buttons when they must be found (≥3:1 on bg).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, UI text, primary icons on bg and sidebar.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Long-form page text on bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, empty states on bg and sidebar (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (Ask, Send, Approve, New). One per view.

tokens.name: button-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on button.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Agent signal, fill: the 'Based' tag, highlighted text Based wrote, In-progress status. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: marker-strong
tokens.usage: Agent signal, line: the 3px marker bar beside content an agent wrote or changed; node fill in the graph.

tokens.name: marker-deep
tokens.usage: Logo base side and shadow only. Not for UI.

tokens.name: marker-calm
tokens.usage: Replaces marker and marker-strong while Calm mode is on.

tokens.name: marker-mint
tokens.usage: Alternative marker fill (user setting: Mint).

tokens.name: marker-mint-strong
tokens.usage: Alternative marker bar (Mint).

tokens.name: marker-sky
tokens.usage: Alternative marker fill (user setting: Sky).

tokens.name: marker-sky-strong
tokens.usage: Alternative marker bar (Sky).

tokens.name: marker-rose
tokens.usage: Alternative marker fill (user setting: Rose).

tokens.name: marker-rose-strong
tokens.usage: Alternative marker bar (Rose).

tokens.name: status-ready
tokens.usage: Status pill 'Ready'. Text is ink.

tokens.name: status-review
tokens.usage: Status pill 'Review'. Text is ink.

tokens.name: status-blocked
tokens.usage: Status pill 'Blocked'. Text is ink.

tokens.name: status-neutral
tokens.usage: Status pill 'Backlog', 'Done'. Text is ink.

tokens.name: synced
tokens.usage: 6px sync dot next to 'Synced'. Never alone — always with the word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors, text on bg (≥4.5:1).

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section labels on Home and in panels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Width shrinks with the square root of the sample size.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Group labels in the sidebar, the 'Based' tag.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: IDs, times, shortcuts, counts, model names. Never for decoration.

styles.name: bold-body
styles.sample: Width shrinks with the square root of the sample size.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row gap in lists; padding of chips and pills.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and composer padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gutter between page text and the margin column.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between Home sections; page side padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Main area padding (Comfortable).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding above page titles.

tokens.name: marker-width
tokens.usage: Width of the agent marker bar. Always 3px, radius 2px.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar width on desktop.

tokens.name: page-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of page text (≈ 70 characters).

tokens.name: margin-column
tokens.usage: Left margin column on pages where agent notes sit.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, the 'Based' tag.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, filters, view toggles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, nav items, inputs, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Composer, menus, board cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon tile corner (of the tile size).

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Floating menus (slash menu, pickers). Nothing else floats.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Selected segment in a segmented control.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggles.

tokens.name: duration
tokens.usage: Menus, panels, the marker bar fading in.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every transition. No bounce, no loops.
